brief:
The Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced scheduled power cuts to areas including Abu Dis, al-Eizariya, Sheikh Sa'd, and al-Sawahira, citing the need to improve service quality and ensure stable electricity supply. The cuts are part of infrastructure development efforts, the Ma'an wire reported.

The company said the disconnections were necessary to maintain safe and continuous electrical service while upgrading the network's foundational systems.
